brief: Evaluate a possible loss and access delay against a fixed payment date without treating time as a return guarantee.

title.pt-BR: O risco precisa de um prazo

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Risk and timing"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "El riesgo necesita un plazo"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "O risco precisa de um prazo"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Evaluate a possible loss and access delay against a fixed payment date without treating time as a return guarantee.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Money needed soon faces a deadline. A possible future recovery cannot pay a bill today.
instruction.misconception: Assuming an investment that may recover eventually can safely fund an unavoidable near-term payment.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the stated quantities, dates and conditions; distinguish a modeled result from a guarantee.

evidence.reasoning: An investment is bought expecting future income or value. It can lose value; the hoped-for gain is uncertain.
Rent is due tomorrow; selling this investment takes days and risks losses. Expected returns cannot meet that deadline.
A longer horizon allows more time to respond to losses. It guarantees neither recovery nor profit nor timely access.
Access timing fails the stated need.
Time does not remove the stated possibility of loss.
The consequence of a loss matters alongside the deadline.
Access and value are separate properties.
Return figures alone cannot establish suitability for a deadline.
The changed deadline changes the decision constraints.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Apply this skill in a later integrated decision with a different constraint.
